body: Issue replicating for the given code for TF version 2.1rc0, kindly find the [gist](https://colab.sandbox.google.com/gist/oanush/1e2b044a36f464442c0c5d41437de4fc/34907.ipynb) of colab.Thanks!

That's not good. 

Thanks for providing such a simple and clean repro of the issue. You are correct; passing `experimental_relax_shapes` when we make the function (https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/blob/master/tensorflow/python/keras/engine/training_v2_utils.py#L122) resolves the issue. Would you like to make the fix PR? (Otherwise I'm happy to do it.)
